name: gitblame
description: See git blame information in the status bar or in-line.

works: Blame of the current line in the status bar
With gitblame.inlineMessageEnabled, the blame after the current line; Show Hover (Ctrl+K Ctrl+U) at the line end shows the commit (Diode 0.19.1 or newer)

readme:
# Git Blame

Shows who last changed the current line and when: in the status bar, and optionally right after the line.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
